opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: The scheme provides up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) category before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; limited to one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over, be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with a UK or ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; applications must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based engagement and outreach projects that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' public engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant

amount.raw: You can apply for a grant of up to £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members of Partner Scientist, Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) categories at time of submission; PhD students actively undertaking a PhD in chemical sciences, or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake an activity that supports their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising a scientific meeting. Round 4 opens 14 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs incurred for care that they usually provide. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling, no deadline stated.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover costs of support or assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition while attending a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals with disabilities and ongoing health conditions with the cost of specific support to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software or hardware. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling, no deadline stated.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) of the RSC before submitting and for the duration of the grant; can be PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Supports research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops. Round 2 open 3 August to 21 September 2026.
